## Description (first paragraph)

PRISM's whole H: drive (1.5M+ files across distinct codebases + the JM DIE archive)
is indexed as a **thin manifest + per-section shards** (`state/shared/modular-index/`).
You "call up a section" instead of loading the full index -- O(1) memory, no OOM,
no 711MB-graph load. Builder/searcher: `scripts/build-modular-index.mjs`.
